audited_source_corrections.action: Restricted the finite countermodel enumeration to universal models, the model class used by the cited S5 completeness and finite-model results.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The decision procedure says to search all finite models, which could reject an S5 theorem merely because it fails on a non-S5 frame, while the proof conclusion correctly invokes finite universal models.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் எதிர்மாதிரித் தேடலை முடிவுறு அனைத்துறவு மாதிரிகளுக்குள் மட்டுப்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Searching unrestricted finite models; adding a separate universal-frame test without naming the resulting search class.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: S5 is complete for universal frames and has the finite-model property there, so dovetailing proofs with finite universal countermodels is sound and terminating.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected procedure enumerate exactly the finite universal models relevant to S5?

audited_source_corrections.action: Changed all four filtered-model arrow endpoints and evaluation points from raw worlds w2 and w5 to their equivalence classes.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The paragraph explicitly discusses adding arrows to the filtered model, whose nodes the adjacent diagram labels [w_i], but then names raw w2 and w5 as endpoints and evaluation points.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் வடிகட்டப்பட்ட மாதிரியின் முனைகளையும் மதிப்பீட்டுப் புள்ளிகளையும்~$[w_2]$, $[w_5]$ என்ற சமான வகுப்புகளாகவே குறிக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Retaining raw worlds that are not generally members of W*; changing the adjacent diagram back to raw worlds.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: A filtration has equivalence classes as worlds, and the contradiction uses truth of Box p and falsity of p at those filtered nodes.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Are every added-arrow endpoint and both truth-evaluation points expressed as classes in the filtered model?

audited_source_corrections.action: Reordered the three theorem conclusions to transitive, euclidean, symmetric so that each numbered statement matches the proof or exercise bearing the same number.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The theorem lists symmetric, transitive, euclidean, but proof item 1 proves transitivity, item 2 invokes Ax5 for euclideanness, and item 3 invokes AxB for symmetry.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் தேற்ற உருப்படிகளை கடத்தல், யூக்ளிடியம், சமச்சீர் என்ற நிறுவலின் வரிசையில் அமைக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: Renumbering and moving the entire proof bodies; leaving every proof number attached to a different theorem claim.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Only the item order is defective; the set of three conclusions and all proof content remain unchanged.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Do theorem items 1, 2 and 3 now correspond respectively to the transitivity proof, Ax5 exercise and AxB exercise?
